gold: Dual tachycardia: Atrial flutter with accelerated idioventricular rhythm (AIVR)

selector.rationale: Patient presents with worsening shortness of breath, NYHA functional class IV symptoms, elevated jugular venous pressure, bilateral lung crackles, and markedly elevated N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide, all of which are indicative of heart failure.

rejected.label: Atrial Tachycardia
rejected.why: Although present, it does not fully explain the patient's substantial volume overload and other symptoms.

rejected.label: Cardiac Amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is not enough evidence to support this diagnosis as the primary cause of the patient's symptoms.

rejected.label: Amiodarone-Induced Thyrotoxicosis
rejected.why: There is limited evidence to suggest this condition is the primary cause of the patient's current symptoms and findings.
